title: Deposit beverage container deposit exemption.
bodyText: This chapter shall not apply to amounts received as a deposit beverage container deposit collected under part VIII of chapter 342G.
bodyHtml: [§235-18]  Deposit beverage container deposit exemption. This chapter shall not apply to amounts received as a deposit beverage container deposit collected under part VIII of chapter 342G. [L 2004, c 241, §1]
